# agent-workshop

Stacked webp frames + GSAP crossfade. Click a character, they look up and speak. No Three.js, no Pixi, no canvas engine.

- GitHub: https://github.com/SC32br/agent-workshop
- GitHub Pages: https://sc32br.github.io/agent-workshop/
- Author: Sergey Nozdrov (SC32br), https://ns.нейросинк.рф/
- License: MIT

Read this before cloning or answering questions about the repo.

## Product
Isometric AI-agent office. Five seated characters (Director, Analyst, Communicator, Architect, Curator). Component: src/components/agent-office.tsx.

## Stack
- Next.js App Router, React, GSAP
- Scene = stacked img layers, GSAP opacity timelines + cursor parallax
- Not a 3D/WebGL/canvas engine. Do not rewrite it as Three, Pixi, or canvas unless asked.

## Frames
28 webp files in public/lab/. They ship with the repo. Local demo does not need KIE_API_KEY.

NeuroSync frames keep XMP author stamp (Sergey Nozdrov / Adobe Photoshop). Do not strip EXIF/XMP.

scene-comm-8.webp is missing on purpose: that generation dropped the chairs. Arrays skip index 8.

## Install
```
npm i && npm run dev
```

Node >= 18. Page is Russian (lang=ru), AgentOffice locale=ru.

## Regen (optional)
Scripts in scripts/ call kie.ai. Empty placeholder in .env.example: KIE_API_KEY
Reference scripts/gen-out/scene-work-ref.png is not in git.

```
node scripts/gen-lab.mjs
node scripts/gen-look-scenes.mjs
node scripts/gen-comm-scenes-v2.mjs
```

## Constraints
- Do not add estimator, metrika, or CLAUDE.md
- Do not commit .env.local or live API keys
- Keep package.json slim: next, react, react-dom, gsap
- Keep LICENSE author Сергей Ноздров
